# Kumail Ali Mirza

> Kumail Ali Mirza is a Performance Marketing Manager with 12+ years in digital and social media marketing, the last 4+ in hands-on paid media buying across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and Snapchat Ads. This site is his résumé and case-study portfolio.

## Key facts
- Role: Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Media & Growth Specialist
- Currently manages PKR 10M+ in monthly ad spend
- Career figures: 35% ROAS improvement, 25-30% CPC reduction, up to 40% CTR increase, 25,000+ conversions delivered
- Industries: e-commerce, FMCG, automotive, fitness and apparel, B2B; international clients in the UAE and North America
- Tools: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Looker Studio, SEMrush, Ahrefs

## Experience (from the résumé)
- Digital Performance Manager, Manhattan Communications Pvt. Ltd. (Mar 2026 - present): leads performance marketing across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and LinkedIn
- Senior Manager, Social Media Marketing, InovioTech Pvt Ltd (Nov 2023 - Apr 2024)
- Social Media Marketing Manager and earlier roles, Salsoft Technologies (Pvt) Ltd (2019 - 2023)
- Social Media Specialist, Horizon Builders (2014 - 2019)
- Freelance: Marketing Specialist (Contract), Magnalog Agency, Florida USA (remote, 2025 - present); Social Media Account Manager, ULegendary Digital, Dubai UAE (2025)
- Education: Master of Advertising, SZABIST (2015-2018); BBA, Iqra University (2010-2015)
- Languages: English, Urdu, Hindi. Open to relocation.
- Résumé download: Kumail_Ali_Mirza_Resume.pdf and Kumail_Ali_Mirza_Resume.docx

## Case studies (platform exports, client names withheld)
- Activewear & fashion e-commerce (Meta Ads, Apr-Oct 2026): 17.5x ROAS, PKR 428K sales spend returned PKR 7.49M in tracked purchase value, 804 purchases at PKR 533 each, best campaign 44.6x.
- Diapers & baby care (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, Jan-Oct 2026): 10.6x ROAS on Meta sales spend (PKR 3.15M returned PKR 33.25M, 9,140 purchases at PKR 344 each), 283M impressions across Meta and TikTok, 3.5M YouTube views.
- Rice & staple foods (Meta Ads, Jan-Oct 2026): 16.0x ROAS, PKR 554K spend returned PKR 8.85M, 1,147 purchases at PKR 483 each, best campaign 40.1x.
- Electrical goods & lighting (Meta Ads, 2026): 10.4M video views at PKR 0.14 each, 710K post engagements, 37.3M impressions, CPM PKR 49.
- AI knowledge app (Google Ads App campaign, 2026): 45,538 Android installs at PKR 17.84 each, 16% CTR, 96.69/100 Optimisation Score.

## Method
Full-funnel paid media: reach and video campaigns build audiences, engagement and profile-visit campaigns warm them, and conversion campaigns timed to seasonal and sale moments turn them into purchases. Each stage is reported against its own KPI.
